trigger: 为一个特征选择构造方法 when its declared inputs are available.

inputs.name: feature_description
inputs.description: Object with required keys `effect`, `required_geometry`, `required_topology`, and `acceptance_conditions` for one feature effect.

inputs.name: target_environment
inputs.description: Object with required keys `host`, `spaceclaim_release`, `api_version`, and `runtime`; other constraints remain explicit members.

inputs.name: available_methods
inputs.description: Array of method objects, each with required keys `method_id`, `scope`, `prerequisites`, `target_environments`, `evidence`, and `stability`.

preconditions: 特征需求已接受且环境约束明确
Use only this single-action procedure; source or upstream instance references must be supplied.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: One 单个特征构造决策 in the common envelope; data fields: construction_decision, alternative_conditions.

postconditions: 方法覆盖目标特征并说明适用前提与替代条件
The typed result and provenance agree with the declared single-action scope; unsupported required fields withhold a resolved result.

implementation.target_environment: Source interpretation or strategy reasoning; no SpaceClaim runtime.
implementation.notes: No standalone deterministic interpreter is claimed. Apply only MS-03 in the hash-bound guidance reference using atomic-reasoning-protocol.md.

ambiguity_checks: Reject a whole-part, multi-feature, or ordered recipe request; choose a method for one feature effect only.
Reject any method not present in the supplied method set and do not invent an API or construction primitive.
When viable methods tie, do not mark the action unresolved solely because of the tie; choose the simpler stable supplied method and explain the choice.
Use the common unresolved envelope only when missing geometry or environment facts could change coverage or method validity.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: No geometry handles are acquired; declarations do not mutate or refresh application topology.

failure_modes.condition: The declared action inputs cannot support a unique required result.
failure_modes.detection: Apply the action rejection rules and inspect raw source evidence.
failure_modes.safe_state: Return actionable unresolved fields; retain original evidence and values.

recovery.action: Supply only the missing source or prerequisite, then repeat this action; do not invent geometry or start application execution.

validation.method: Inspect named inputs, result fields, procedure and rejection rules for MS-03
validate_atomic_reasoning.py with an actual source manifest; separately review interpretation against raw material.
validation.expected: 方法覆盖目标特征并说明适用前提与替代条件

host_checked.notes: Host structure/invariants and bounded independent source evaluation; no automatic promotion.

evidence_level.notes: Candidate. Structural tests cannot establish source interpretation accuracy or any SpaceClaim runtime capability.
